ceramic.title: Vase. Made from dark brown recycled glass. The vase has a rounded, bulbous, slightly concave base and tapers to a narrow mouth. Around the edge of the mouth is an undulating decorative lip. Bubbled appearance to the fabric of the glass. [MdeA 15/11/99]

Vase made from clear recycled glass. The vase has a bulbous body which narrows to form a slender neck and then flares out to form a wide mouth. There are three lips in the mouth. The base of the vase is concave. The outside of the vase is decorated with glass strands which have been wound round the vase. The body of the vase is cracked and in one place a section of the glass strand has come away from the body. [MdeA 15/11/99]
